narrative.northStar: A form filled in with a blue ballpoint pen
narrative.overview: The existing direction combines a plain public-service structure with the identity of form paper. White surfaces sit on a cool grey desk. Graphite text and hairline rules organize the work; ballpoint blue identifies actions and selections. The audience includes occasional computer users and people reading on small phones, so clear labels and visible actions come first.
keyCharacteristics: One legible type family, small corners, and ruled separation.
A hand-drawn ink underline and tick as the signature, implemented in InkMark.tsx.
Real resume output used for previews, with no invented testimonials or usage counts.
dos: Do use semantic tokens for both themes.
Do test narrow phones, desktop, long text, and keyboard interactions.
Do keep PDF output independent of editor controls and theme.
donts: Don’t hide essential actions behind hover.
Don’t substitute decorative imagery for real resume previews.
Don’t add gradients, floating statistics, or invented product claims.
